{{Top|leg}}
The '''Talaseans''' were the inhabitants of a small [[Farm/Legends|farming]] colony on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Talasea]]. The Talaseans built a small settlement, including a planetary [[Governor/Legends|governor's]] [[Talasea's Planetary Governor's Palace|palace]], and maintained livestock including [[Bantha/Legends|banthas]] and [[Rycrit/Legends|rycrits]]. Following the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Talaseans offered shelter to a [[Unidentified Jedi (Talasea)|Jedi Knight]] escaping the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|destruction]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], who was hunting the fugitive, discovered that the Talaseans were hiding the Jedi. Vader murdered every Talasean, and their farming herds returned to the wild.<ref name="EGTPM">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref>
